Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role

We are looking for a Student Worker to join our Global Clinical Drug Supply organization in our HQ office in Valby. In this role, you will support the team across an international department with operational and administrative tasks that contribute to the development and distribution of medicinal products for our clinical trial programs. You will learn navigate GMP and GDP handling.  You will become part of a collaborative environment with close interaction across teams and gain valuable insight into how a global biotech company operates.

Responsibilities/tasks

As a Student Worker within Global Clinical Drug Supply organization, you will participate in various tasks. The responsibilities includes but are not limited to:

Supply Chain

• Perform accountability and reconciliation support

• Assist batch documentation and reconciliation

Project Management

• Input on ancillary requests into trackers/systems

• Support information retrieval and data collection

• Assist with creation project related documents and presentations

• Supporting preparation for audits and inspections

• Developing and maintaining important trackers and additional documents

Document Handling

• Support shipment documentation

• Support return shipment documentation

• Assist with Electronic Document Archiving

• Assist with electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) management

• Checking translations

• General ad hoc administrative support

Your work will be aligned with SOPs and Work Instructions and will be provided with the required training to perform these tasks.

Requirements

• You are currently studying Natural Sciences, Supply Chain, Business or a related field and are ideally in your second year of your Bachelor’s degree, with plans to continue into a Master’s degree

• Familiar with MS Office – Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint and with a flair for navigating different IT systems

• Willing to collaborate in an office environment.

Moreover, you meet the following personal requirements:

• You can work independently as well as in teams

• You are highly organized with the ability to manage multiple conflicting deadlines and competing priorities

• You are capable of prioritizing workflow within a dynamic work environment

• You have a keen eye and are detail-oriented

• You are result- and goal-driven and committed to contributing to the overall success of Genmab

• You enjoy taking ownership

• You are passionate, eager to learn, flexible and dedicated

• You are service-minded and good at meeting deadlines

• You write and speak English

We are looking for a motivated student who is able to work approximately 15 hours per week with flexible hours alongside their studies.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK180,00---180,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

jobs.occupation: Quality Engineer, Automation and IT, at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you’re energized by quality, validation, and complex Automation and IT projects in pharma engineering, we’d love to hear from you!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for an AIT Quality Engineer to join our AIT Project Quality Management team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, driving, and delivering validation and quality activities within complex Automation and IT projects in the pharmaceutical and life science industry.

You will work as part of multidisciplinary project teams and act as a trusted advisor on validation strategy, GMP compliance, quality risk management, and project quality execution from project initiation through to handover. The role combines hands-on technical validation expertise with project quality management responsibilities, ensuring that deliverables, quality expectations, timelines, and customer requirements are aligned throughout the project lifecycle.

Location Denmark - Kalundborg

Experience Minimum 5 Years

Department AIT Project Quality Management

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As an AIT Quality Engineer, you’ll be:

• Leading CQV and validation activities for automation, IT, computerized systems, and equipment interfaces in GMP-regulated projects.

• Developing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, test protocols, and summary reports.

• Executing qualification and testing activities while ensuring compliance with GMP requirements, industry standards, and customer expectations.

• Collaborating with customers, suppliers, and project teams throughout FAT, SAT, commissioning, validation, and handover.

• Managing validation risks, deviations, compliance issues, and mitigation actions across projects.

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Able to work independently while building strong relationships with stakeholders.

• Comfortable balancing compliance, quality, timelines, and project risks.

• Eager to share knowledge and support the development of colleagues.

• Skilled at communicating complex validation topics in a practical way.

• Motivated by collaboration and delivering high-quality results in project environments.

**What You Bring To The Role

**In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• A B.Sc., M.Sc., or equivalent degree in engineering, IT, life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related field.

• Experience within CQV, validation, GMP, QA, or project quality management in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life science industry.

• Hands-on experience preparing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, and test protocols.

• Knowledge of GMP, GAMP 5, ISPE guidance, data integrity, quality risk management, and validation lifecycle management.

• Ability to advise customers and project teams on validation strategy, compliance risks, and quality-related decisions.

**Life at NNE

**NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer **here .

****Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

****Deadline of application is 27th November 2026

**Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Rebecca Larsen at +45 31 91 88 47.

**Please note:

**

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

**Fair hiring:

**At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Still searching for the right opportunity?

**If this position isn’t quite what you're looking for, but you know someone who would excel in this role, please share this job post. And don’t forget to explore our other exciting opportunities — your future role at NNE might be just around the corner! Visit our Career Site

jobs.occupation: Head Chef for a New Italian Restaurant in Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Head Chef for a New Italian Restaurant in Esbjerg

We’re opening an Italian restaurant in Esbjerg and looking for a Head Chef to lead our kitchen team of six. You’ll join us before opening, with a chance to shape the menu, organise the kitchen and build a team that works well together.

We want to keep the menu small and give each dish the attention it deserves. You’ll develop a focused selection of Italian dishes that make the most of seasonal ingredients. Alongside it, you’ll work with our pizza chefs on a dedicated Neapolitan pizza menu.

Your responsibilities

• 
Menu development. Create and test dishes, write recipes and help the team deliver consistent quality across every service.

• 
Team leadership and rotas. Plan shifts for the six-person team, assign responsibilities and make time to train and support your chefs.

• 
Daily service. Organise prep, cook alongside the team and keep service running smoothly when the restaurant is full.

• 
Kitchen finances. Cost dishes and work closely with management to keep track of food costs, labour hours and waste.

• 
Purchasing and food safety. Place orders, work with suppliers, manage stock and oversee food safety procedures.

About you

You have hands-on experience cooking Italian food and have led a kitchen team as a Head Chef or Sous Chef. You know how to turn an idea into a dish that tastes great, works during a busy service and meets its target food cost.

You give clear direction and lead by example. You notice when a colleague needs a hand, and you keep communication calm and respectful, even when the orders come in thick and fast.

What we offer

You’ll have a say in the first menu, how the kitchen is organised and how the team works together. You’ll work directly with management, with room to put your ideas into practice. Salary will reflect your experience and qualifications.

This is a full-time position with morning, lunch, evening and weekend shifts. The start date is flexible.

Interested in leading the kitchen? Apply through this listing with your CV and a few lines about your experience with Italian cooking and kitchen leadership.

**About The Role

This is a high-impact role ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys building relationships, and wants to launch or accelerate a career in SaaS sales.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Research and identify target accounts and decision-makers within our ideal customer profile (ICP).

• Qualify inbound and outbound leads using BANT (or similar frameworks) to determine fit, budget, authority, need, and timeline.

• Book qualified discovery/demo meetings for Account Executives and maintain accurate pipeline data in our CRM.

• Collaborate closely with Marketing on campaign follow-up and with Sales on account strategies.

• Continuously refine messaging, sequences, and outreach strategies based on performance data.

• Consistently hit or exceed monthly targets for meetings booked, opportunities created, and pipeline generated.

• Maintain detailed records of all activity and customer interactions in the CRM (HubSpot).

**Requirements

• 1–3 years of experience in sales development, inside sales, or a related customer-facing role (SaaS experience strongly preferred).

• Proven track record of hitting activity and meeting/booking targets.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage busy decision-makers.

**What We Offer

**

• Competitive base salary + uncapped commission/bonus structure.

• Comprehensive benefits package

• Clear career path into Account Executive or other sales leadership roles.

• Ongoing training, coaching, and professional development.

• Office / Remote / Hybrid based work environment with a collaborative, high-performing team culture

Location: Copenhagen office

Hybrid: Three days a week in the office

Language: Fluent English. Norwegian (native or fluent) strongly preferred

Markets: Norway and Sweden

Exciting news: NewGen is expanding into new markets with existing clients. We're building our first in-market team in the Nordics to cover Norway and Sweden. We're looking for local talent to help us launch it and shape how NewGen works in the region from day one.

About NewGen

Welcome to NewGen. We're a global social creative and creator agency made up of over 100 talented people worldwide, with offices in London, Manchester and New York. We partner with leading brands to shape culture, tell stories that matter and harness the power of social first creative and creators to drive meaningful impact. As a fast growing agency with a collaborative, ambitious spirit, we bring together data, strategy, creativity and innovation to deliver work that cuts through, connects and creates conversation.

Founded by our 30-under-30 co-founders, NewGen is an independent agency working with some of the world's biggest brands. Privately owned and built to challenge the big networks and traditional agencies, we move fast, live social and know that fresh ideas can compete with anyone. In fact, we know it's the only way to deliver work consumers care about.

Our work is trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, including Pepsi, Samsung, Amazon, SEGA and CashApp. Just as importantly, we're the agency of choice for leading creators shaping culture today, from KSI and Amelia Dimoldenberg to PewDiePie. When the people driving conversations and influencing audiences trust us, it's no surprise that the world's most ambitious brands do too.

Our Non-Negotiables

• Energy: Get involved, be heard and contribute. This isn't the place for an easy ride. We want people who bring energy and ideas.

• Quality: Quality comes first. If it doesn't feel right, speak up. Everything we create should push boundaries and break new ground.

• Collaboration: We win as a team. No egos, no judgement: just support, collaboration and collective success.

• Creativity: We thrive on fresh thinking. New ideas and bold approaches are what keep us moving forward.

• Partnership: Be a great partner to our clients. Everything we do should deliver on their objectives and create a positive, collaborative experience. This is paramount.

The Role

We're looking for a commercially minded and socially native Account Director to lead our client relationships across Norway and Sweden from Copenhagen. As one of our first in-market hires, you'll own senior day to day client relationships, lead client onboarding and make sure work is strategically sharp, creatively ambitious and commercially strong.

You'll lead the influencer scope from day one, then take on social as it launches. You'll work closely with our in-market influencer managers and social creatives, as well as our strategy, creative and influencer teams in the UK. You are both a leader and a doer. You bring clarity, pace and energy, you know what great looks like and you protect the team while raising standards.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Accounts with Confidence

• Act as senior day to day client lead across Norway and Sweden

• Build trusted relationships with marketing stakeholders in market

• Drive proactive thinking rather than reactive servicing

• Provide clear senior counsel on social strategy and performance

Launch and Onboard

• Lead client onboarding as new scopes start, setting up ways of working, approvals and reporting

• Help build our in-market team and processes from the ground up

• Bring local market knowledge to every brief so the work lands in both markets

Own Delivery Excellence

• Oversee campaign delivery from brief through to wrap

• Make sure timelines, scope and budgets are tightly managed

• Anticipate risk and solve problems early

• Maintain high standards across all outputs

Drive Commercial Performance

• Be accountable for revenue and margin performance

• Identify organic growth opportunities

• Support SOW development and forecasting

• Make sure accounts are properly scoped and resourced

Elevate Strategic Output

• Partner closely with Strategy and Creative so ideas are insight led and socially native

• Make sure deliverables ladder back to client business objectives

• Push for measurable impact across campaigns

Lead and Develop the Team

• Guide and support the in-market team day to day, including influencer managers and social creatives

• Create a high performance, supportive team culture

• Provide clear feedback and development pathways

• Drive accountability and ownership across the team

Champion Collaboration

• Work seamlessly with influencer, creative, production and data teams across markets

• Make sure clients get a joined up experience across disciplines and markets

• Contribute to agency wide initiatives and improvements

Social First x Brand Impact

Being socially native is at the heart of everything we do at NewGen. We're not an advertising agency. We live and breathe culture, constantly plugged into the trends, conversations and creators shaping the world.

To succeed here you need a deep understanding of the creator landscape in Norway and Sweden, an instinct for what resonates online and the ability to turn trends and cultural insight into work that feels authentic, bold and social first. It's ok to be chronically online.

We'd Love You To Have

• Fluent English. Norwegian (native or fluent) strongly preferred

• 8+ years experience in social creative or integrated agency roles

• Experience leading large accounts or multi market campaigns, ideally across the Nordics

• Strong commercial acumen

• Deep knowledge of social platforms and creator culture in the Nordics

• Experience managing and developing teams

• Confident presentation and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to turn creative ideas into measurable business results

About ALK

ALK is a global pharmaceutical company specializing in allergy immunotherapy. We are driven by a high level of professionalism, integrity, an open-minded approach and contributing to an inspiring and fun working environment together with our colleagues. We provide an attractive working environment for individuals looking for both personal and professional development. You will be part of an engaged and informal team who values skill and knowledge creation.

The position

We are looking for a Group Production Controller to support the measurement and follow-up of manufacturing financial performance across ALK Group and its individual production sites.

You will contribute to transparent, consistent, and high-quality financial reporting for the Product Supply leadership team by preparing analyses that improve understanding of COGS and margin development. The role acts as a finance partner to CMC and Group Product Supply support functions, while supporting group budgeting, forecasting, and planning processes for manufacturing costs.

You will work with VPs and other management across ALK Group globally, as well as the Product Supply Finance organization. The role also offers the opportunity to drive transparency, improve financial processes, and simplify and automate reporting and performance management.

This role requires occasional travel, approximately 2–3 times per year.

Responsibilities

• 
Prepare and maintain recurring monthly reporting on manufacturing financial performance.

• 
Monitor results against budgets, forecasts, and targets, explaining variances through operational and financial drivers.

• 
Track operational improvement initiatives and the delivery and financial realization of their benefits.

• 
Act as a day-to-day finance partner to site CMC and Group Product Supply support functions by providing high-quality planning and reporting.

• 
Prepare analyses with clear, actionable insights and recommendations for management and Product Supply stakeholders.

• 
Drive transparency in the cost development of ALK-produced products and the financial performance of Product Supply.

• 
Support the standardization and automation of reporting processes and financial models.

• 
Drive continuous improvement of systems and processes within the area.

Experience and qualifications

• 
Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.

• 
2–4 years of experience in production controlling, FP&A, business finance, or a similar role.

• 
Experience from an industrial or manufacturing environment is preferred.

• 
Experience with performance management, forecasting, budgeting, cost control, and financial performance tracking.

• 
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

• 
Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g. SAP) is preferred.

• 
Experience with business intelligence and reporting tools is preferred.

• 
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively across departments.

• 
Proactive and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

• 
Fluent written and spoken English.

Become a part of ALK

**We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our Platform team and help us scale infrastructure, CI/CD, and observability across our growing backend ecosystem.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.

**

**

With that growth comes a need to strengthen how we tell our story. We are therefore looking for an experienced Communications Manager who can help sharpen our corporate voice, increase our international visibility and turn our technology, people and ambitions into compelling stories for the audiences that matter.

You will join our Marketing & Communications team and have a real opportunity to shape both the role and the way we work with corporate communications going forward.

Shape our corporate voice and international position

As Communications Manager, you will play a central role in shaping how Weibel communicates and positions itself towards media, authorities, partners, current and future employees and other key stakeholders.

You will report to our Director of Marketing & Communications and work across the organization to build a distinctive corporate voice and a more proactive communications approach.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Driving Weibel’s corporate communications and PR across Denmark and key international markets, building media relationships and proactively identifying and pitching relevant stories.

Your profile

You are an experienced communications professional with strong editorial judgement, a sharp eye for a good story and the confidence to advise senior stakeholders. You know how to turn complex technology, business developments and strategic priorities into clear and compelling communication, and you are equally comfortable setting direction and producing high-quality content yourself.

You thrive in an international environment where technology, business and external affairs intersect, and where communication requires curiosity, sound judgement and integrity. Experience from defense, government, B2G or another regulated and stakeholder-intensive environment will be an advantage.

We imagine that you bring:

• Relevant experience from corporate communications, PR, government communications or journalism

• Strong experience with media relations, corporate positioning and proactive storytelling

• The ability to advise senior stakeholders and develop compelling narratives around complex subjects

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English

• Experience developing content across corporate channels, including LinkedIn and digital platforms

Contact and application

Please apply through our website using the Apply button.

If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact Patricia Brusgaard, Director of Marketing and Communications, at +45 31 46 78 23 or PABR@weibel.dk.

The deadline for applications is December 7, 2026, and we expect to conduct interviews during weeks 49 and 50.

Please note that this position requires a criminal record with no remarks and the ability to obtain a security clearance.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.description:
Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for a position in which you can set direction and help shape our company? If so, then you could be the newest addition to our Commercial Excellence team as Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights.

At DFDS, we are strengthening how we use pricing, customer data and commercial insights to improve profitability, support growth and create greater value for our customers.

As Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights, you will play a key role in this transformation. You will drive the development of pricing capabilities, help establish a stronger customer data foundation and turn commercial data into actionable insights that support decision-making across the business.

You will join our Commercial Excellence team, which works across DFDS to enable more efficient, data-driven and profitable commercial operations. Through common tools, processes and insights, we help strengthen commercial performance while supporting local business ownership and flexibility.

Be part of the movement - and play your part.

About The Role As Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights, you will own and drive DFDS' pricing excellence and commercial insights agenda across a complex, international business.

This is a highly strategic role focused on strengthening pricing capabilities, improving commercial decision-making, and unlocking value from customer and commercial data. Working across business units and functions, you will lead key transformation initiatives, establish scalable frameworks and best practices, and drive the adoption of tools, processes, and data-driven ways of working.

Operating in a highly decentralized organisation, you will balance the implementation of common standards and governance with the need for local ownership and commercial flexibility.

Pricing Excellence and Commercial Insights is an area of increasing strategic importance and executive attention. You will play a key role in elevating its maturity and impact, working closely with Commercial leadership, Data & Technology, Customer Engagement, Tender Management, and Tools & Processes to deliver measurable business value.

**Key priorities

**

• Drive the Pricing Excellence strategy across business units, establishing governance, standards and best practices while enabling local flexibility

• Own the business vision and roadmap for our pricing platform, ensuring continuous development, adoption and value creation

• Lead the digitalisation of pricing processes across CRM, contract management and pricing solutions

• Build and mature Commercial Insights capabilities, transforming data into actionable recommendations and commercial decision support

• Shape the long-term strategy for our customer data foundation in partnership with Data & Technology

• Identify opportunities to improve profitability and reduce revenue leakage through analytics, automation and AI

• Facilitate alignment, collaboration and knowledge sharing across business units and senior stakeholders

• Translate complex data and insights into clear recommendations for management and commercial leadership

**About You

**At DFDS, we believe the strongest teams are built through diverse perspectives, experiences and ways of thinking.

With this in mind, we think that you are a strategic and commercially minded professional who enjoys solving complex problems and turning insights into action. You combine strong analytical capabilities with the ability to influence stakeholders, challenge existing ways of working and drive change across a matrix organisation.

You thrive at the intersection of business, data and technology and are motivated by creating tangible commercial impact through pricing excellence, customer insights and continuous improvement.

We think the ideal person for this position will bring the following:

• 5+ years of relevant experience within Pricing, Commercial Excellence, Revenue Management, Strategy, Management Consulting, Business Development, Finance, Analytics or a related field

• A strong track record of driving cross-functional initiatives and delivering results through collaboration and influence rather than formal authority

• Experience operating in complex organisations with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

• A strategic mindset combined with the ability to translate ideas and opportunities into practical solutions and business outcomes

• Experience working with commercial tools and platforms such as CRM, pricing, CPQ, contract management or business intelligence solutions

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights and recommendations

• Interest in leveraging data, automation and AI to improve commercial performance and decision-making

• The ability to communicate complex topics clearly and confidently to both operational teams and senior stakeholders

• A curiosity for understanding customers, commercial processes and business drivers, combined with a willingness to challenge the status quo

Working at DFDS

While you’re with us, we want you to develop. At DFDS, development happens first and foremost through real work. We will also offer training and support when needed.

We promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.

If you think your personality, skills, experience, and aspirations match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

**We look forward to hearing from you.

**This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.
